result_summary.title: Data loss and missing records in Cohort Builder (ME Sandbox)
result_summary.description: We are reporting a critical data integrity issue in the Cohort Builder tool within the ME sandbox environment. Users are experiencing data mismatches and, in many cases, actual data loss. Specific records that should exist in the cohorts are completely missing. This affects 22,918 users and requires immediate investigation to recover or restore the missing data.
